high_level_description: The image depicts a group of glowing jellyfish swimming in what appears to be an aquarium or underwater environment. The jellyfish are illuminated with a soft blue light, creating a serene and ethereal atmosphere. Each jellyfish has a translucent bell-shaped body with long, flowing tentacles that are also illuminated, giving them a delicate and almost otherworldly appearance. The background is dark, which enhances the luminosity of the jellyfish, making them stand out prominently. There are no people or other objects visible in the image, focusing all attention on the jellyfish themselves.
